ai_analysis.revenue_effect: Unclear in the short term, though any reputational damage could slow customer acquisition in private banking, wealth management, or corporate advisory segments.

ai_analysis.cost_effect: Operating expenses are expected to rise due to internal legal reviews, forensic audit costs, compliance enhancements, and legal defense fees.
ai_analysis.competitive_effect: Perceived corporate governance lapses could temporarily dent market confidence relative to key private sector peers like ICICI Bank and Axis Bank.
ai_analysis.regulatory_effect: Substantial regulatory risk involving potential investigations by SEBI and RBI into violations of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) regulations, which could lead to fines or administrative warnings.
ai_analysis.short_term: Immediate focus on internal investigations, potential executive suspensions or resignations, media scrutinization, and responses to regulatory inquiries over the next 0-3 months.
ai_analysis.medium_long_term: Implementation of stricter internal information controls and potential delays or added scrutiny on future strategic transactions and regulatory approvals over 3 months to several years.
ai_analysis.second_order_effects: Stricter internal communication policies, increased attrition or hiring friction among senior management, and heightened scrutiny from institutional ESG/governance investors.
ai_analysis.key_uncertainty: The severity of findings by SEBI and RBI regarding executive involvement and whether formal sanctions or bans will be imposed.
